title: Anatomical Fleur-de-Lis Vortex
description: A vibrant, stylized anatomical human heart is centered within a large, multi-colored fleur-de-lis shape. The composition sits atop a swirling white and black vortex that spirals downward against a black background, surrounded by colorful abstract circles, rings, and a flowing white and pink ribbon-like form at the top.
prompt: A vibrant surreal painting on black background featuring a detailed anatomical human heart at the center of a large multi-colored fleur-de-lis symbol. The fleur-de-lis is composed of bright pink, blue, green, and purple sections with circular patterns. A powerful white and black spiral vortex swirls downward from the symbol, surrounded by floating colorful rings, bubbles, and abstract shapes in yellow, pink, and blue. A flowing white and pink ribbon-like form curves across the top of the composition.
